stem.text: A stationary sound wave is formed in a tube of length $L$ that is closed at one end.
The diagram shows the positions of the nodes and antinodes of the stationary wave.

stem.alt: Tube drawn as a rectangle with a closed left end, with filled dots marked on its axis and labels node, node, antinode and antinode pointing to them.

stem.text: Which graph shows the variation of the amplitude $a$ of the wave with distance $x$ measured from the closed end of the tube?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis a and horizontal axis x, marked 0 at the origin and L at the right, showing a curve with arches.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis a and horizontal axis x, marked 0 at the origin and L at the right, showing a single smooth wave curve.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis a and horizontal axis x, marked 0 at the origin and L at the right, showing three arches of equal height.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis a and horizontal axis x, marked 0 at the origin and L at the right, showing a sinusoidal curve with peaks above and below the axis.
